ai.title: SDK treats 503 model capacity refusals as final
ai.summary: The SDK model provider now classifies HTTP 503 responses carrying the `model_at_capacity` error code as final, non-retryable refusals. Previously, the AI SDK's retry loop treated all 503 responses as transient, causing it to re-queue the step and retry up to four times with backoff before failing. This change stops the retry loop on the first refusal, immediately surfacing the server's capacity message or the SDK's fallback copy to the client.

ai.unknowns: The diff does not indicate whether the CLI has been updated to specifically parse and display the `model_at_capacity` error code in its UI, though it will now receive the error immediately rather than after a failed retry sequence.

ai.title: Agent runtime logs skipped mechanical compactions and guards BYOK
ai.summary: The agent runtime introduces `compactDeterministically`, which runs the mechanical compaction pass and logs a `mechanical_compaction.skipped` event when the pass throws or cannot shrink the history, replacing a silent no-op that previously left deterministic-cohort misses invisible. In `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts`, `usesDeterministicCompaction` now explicitly excludes the shared `BYOK_LOCAL_USER_ID` identifier so that SDK BYOK runs without a named user stay on the model handoff arm instead of all flipping to mechanical compaction at once. The `deterministic_cohort` boolean is threaded through all compaction Axiom events (completed, fallback, skipped, followup) so operators can compare arms by cohort rather than by mode. The `compactRunState` SDK seam now caps its rewritten history at `MECHANICAL_HISTORY_TOKENS` (12k) instead of filling the full context window. Three other changes: the `spawn_agents` delegation check prevents re-providing stale file reads in the compaction working set, the to-do progress reminder now ships as an Axiom-only event without user IDs, and Space Bunny Alpha's comment in `freebuff-models.ts` is updated to reflect its OpenCode Zen lane and withdrawal.
ai.evidence: In `packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts`, the new `compactDeterministically` function wraps `compactMechanically` and logs `MECHANICAL_COMPACTION_SKIPPED_EVENT` on failure; `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts` adds a `userId === BYOK_LOCAL_USER_ID` guard to `usesDeterministicCompaction`.

changes.what: New `compactDeterministically` exports a wrapped mechanical pass that logs `mechanical_compaction.skipped` with a fixed `error_kind` when compaction cannot apply, making deterministic-cohort misses observable.
`usesDeterministicCompaction` now excludes `BYOK_LOCAL_USER_ID` so signed-out and SDK BYOK runs share the model handoff arm until the cohort reaches 100 percent.

The `deterministic_cohort` boolean is added to all compaction-related Axiom event field schemas and threaded through `compactHistoryNow`, `compactMechanically`, and `compactWithModelOrFallback` telemetry.
The compaction working set now treats `spawn_agents` calls as delegating edits, so files read before a spawn are stubbed rather than re-provided as full content.

`compactRunState` documentaion updated to state that the rewritten history is capped at `MECHANICAL_HISTORY_TOKENS` rather than sized to `maxContextLength`, and BYOK user ID resolution now imports the shared constant.
